label: MBR745 Schottky
description:
Features

• LowPowerLoss,HighEfficiency
• HighSurgeCapacity
• MetalSiliconJunction,MajorityCarrierConduction • HighCurrentCapacity,LowForward-VoltageDrop • GuardRingforOver-VoltageProtection(OVP)

Usage:

Low-Voltage,High-FrequencyInverters • Free Wheeling and Polarity Protection
